text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet stands alone on the
training track.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I don't understand... I want to run, but
my body
just won't listen.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'll never be number one like this. If this
keeps
up...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I know what I have to do, but... I just
can't...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's concerning to see her in this state. I'd
better
rethink her race schedule.
